siteTypes.title: 1-Page Quick Launchpad
siteTypes.simpleDesc: A single, high-converting scrollable page. Perfect for landing pages, portfolio, or single service launch.
siteTypes.whoIsItFor: Freelancers, new businesses, single product launch

siteTypes.title: Complete Multi-Page Website
siteTypes.simpleDesc: Full professional website with separate pages: Home, About Us, Services/Menu, Photo Gallery, and Contact.
siteTypes.whoIsItFor: Catering, Salons, Clinics, Contractors, Local Brands

siteTypes.title: Online Shop / E-Commerce Store
siteTypes.simpleDesc: Sell your products online with automatic shopping cart, UPI & Card payments, and WhatsApp order alerts.

siteTypes.title: Custom Booking / Valuation Portal
siteTypes.simpleDesc: Interactive system with client login, automatic trade-in price valuation (like Ecofone), or complex booking flows.

features.title: 1-Click WhatsApp Chat Button
features.whatItDoes: Visitors can tap one button on mobile to chat with you directly on WhatsApp. No long forms to fill.
features.whyYouNeedIt: Generates 3x more inquiries because customers in India prefer direct WhatsApp conversations.

features.title: Smart Contact & Inquiry Form
features.whatItDoes: Collects customer name, phone number, and message, and emails it to you immediately.
features.whyYouNeedIt: Included completely FREE in all website plans.

features.title: Online Appointment & Booking System
features.whatItDoes: Allows clients to choose their date and time slot online (like Singh's Glamour Salon).
features.whyYouNeedIt: Saves you hours of phone calls and prevents double-bookings automatically.

features.title: Interactive Price / Menu Estimator
features.whatItDoes: Clients can select food items or services and see instant estimated costs (like S Caterers).
features.whyYouNeedIt: Builds instant trust and qualifies high-budget leads automatically without manual quoting.

features.title: UPI & Card Online Payment Gateway
features.whatItDoes: Accept advance booking fees or product sales via PhonePe, GPay, Paytm, UPI, and Cards.
features.whyYouNeedIt: Get paid instantly into your bank account via Razorpay/Cashfree integration.

features.title: Photo & Video Showcase Gallery
features.whatItDoes: Organized albums for your photos and videos with zoom and category filters.
features.whyYouNeedIt: Show off your best work, wedding setups, salon makeovers, or products visually.

features.title: English + Hindi Language Switcher
features.whatItDoes: Adds a toggle button so visitors can read your whole website in English or Hindi.
features.whyYouNeedIt: Makes your website accessible to all regional Indian customers.

features.title: Self-Edit Admin Login (Change Content Yourself)
features.whatItDoes: A simple password-protected panel where you can edit your prices, photos, and text anytime.
features.whyYouNeedIt: You won't have to pay a developer every time your price list or menu changes.
